verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail's own docs say the mailbox handles shipments and that packages can be shipped to any address, with savings for bundling. That covers package forwarding and consolidation. Missing for 10: evidence that packages from all major carriers (UPS, FedEx, DHL, etc.) are accepted, a documented hold-for-pickup option, details on how consolidation works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a digital nomad, the address accepts packages from all major carriers and can consolidate or hold them for pickup or forwarding
